title: Why Doctolib Chose to Meet Every Doctor Face to Face
conflicts: Founders: 2014 sources list four (with Thomas Landais), Doctolib's 2017 release and FrenchWeb 2016 list three, Wikipedia names Steve Abou-Rjeily; the edition names the three the company itself gave later. Early team: ten (MIT Technology Review 2016) vs eight (Niox-Chateau in Doctolib's 2017 release); ten is attributed to his later description. 2015 round: EUR 18m (two sources) vs EUR 20m (MIT TR); EUR 18m used. Practitioner counts are dated company figures. MIT TR's 'professional tennis player' contradicted by HEC and JDN; tennis left out.
notes: Episode is the 2013-2015 founding go-to-market: a practice-management subscription rather than lead generation, sold face to face. Most early detail comes from French trade press (FrenchWeb, Le Quotidien du Médecin, BFM via Internet Archive); Les Echos and Paris Match could not be fetched. The 80% field time, 6 p.m. rule and medical-assistant work are his own 2025 recollection to HEC, attributed as such.
